'''Nareen Cale''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at the end of the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and a veteran of the [[New Sith Wars]], Nareen Cale was tasked by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to assist in the obfuscation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]], a highly contested world fought over for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] by the Order and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Altering official war reports to indicate that the planet was decimated by the Sith, Cale reclassified the planet as uninhabitable on [[Star map/Legends|star-charts]] and [[astrogation map]]s.<ref name="NoP" />
